body.x: COLOUD SPORTS INTRODUCING THE SNAP DESIGNED FOR ACTIVE LIFESTYLESColoud Headphones(coloud.com), a maker of headphones, introduced "The Snap" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

The Snap is designed to find the perfect fit and keep the earpiece secured in your ear while exercising with AnchorLoop, an adjustable loop within the earpiece. Also, the reflective cable makes you more visible during the late-night run, and the lightweight cable clip that snaps onto your clothing reduces friction noise and holds the cable in place at all times.
